verdict.rationale: Blaxel documents that sandboxes automatically go to standby after a few seconds of inactivity and resume in under 25ms 'even after weeks'. It also offers point-in-time snapshots with rollback and an archive/unarchive flow that keeps the filesystem, and its expiration docs reference snapshot storage, which implies standby state is persisted. The docs say this delivers the core pause/resume story, but memory preservation is only implied by the fast resume, not stated outright. missing for 10: explicit statement that in-memory/process state survives standby, a documented developer-triggered pause API (standby is automatic on inactivity), independent or hands-on corroboration.
